name: qkd_kvwq_leaf_s_w129_m

job.purpose: KV write-queue leaf (128 bound on the KV/system die): native pin re-route (lane strap pin register, recipe-2 pin registers).

benches.name: kvwq_leaf_slot_exact
benches.note: 60,000 random cycles through the die buses (field offsets generated from kv_die BINDINGS): feed n == c 293 bits exact, take / replace, one push per held word with exact {sec, data, tag}, done on the held tag, bad on any other return, done chain OR; coverage floors on pushes / dones / bads / replaced

benches.name: kvwq_leaf_slot_mutant
benches.note: OT_QKD_KVWQ_LEAF_MUT inverts one CDC write data bit at the pin

reroute_reason.why: native pin audit (root 07:12, lead queue v1.1 rank 7): launch 231.1 (48 outputs, w[55]) / capture 365.5 (lane[0] strap fanning into the body's lane compares); the wrapper captures the static lane strap in one flop at its pin (no data-path cycle change) and the kit takes the recipe-2 pin registers (HB2 pads, dedicated launch flops).

structural_change: np1: lane strap pin register + recipe 2 pin defaults (native audit).
